endorsements.name: Artem Polynko
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-4942
endorsements.description: The Custom Dash plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via admin settings in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level permissions and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This only affects multi-site installations and installations where unfiltered_html has been disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.4)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
